usedFor: Slack and Swit both hold team chat, so “New Message Arrives” in Swit can run “Send Message” in Slack.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Arrives” in Swit, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Messages in one Swit channel are repeated in Slack, so people on either side stay informed.

watchOut: “New Message on Slack” covers every channel and direct message, so mirroring it into Swit could expose private chats.
